blocks.text: South Surrey / White Rock houses: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of houses in South Surrey / White Rock peaked at 655 in May 2026 and bottomed at 417 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in April 2026 with 72. The reported sale price moved from $1,625,000 to $1,628,000, a change of +0.2%.
